name: Los Altos Counselor-in-Training (CIT) Program
org: City of Los Altos, Community Services
what_you_do: Help Recreation Leaders run city summer camps. You lead songs, games, and activities for younger campers in a low-pressure first leadership role.
who_can_apply: Teens ages 13 to 15. No experience with children is needed. Acceptance is not guaranteed. Los Altos residents pay a lower fee, but others can apply.
pay_detail: You pay a weekly fee. Half day: $125 for Los Altos residents, $148 for others. Full day: $250 for residents, $296 for others.
duration: Weekly camp sessions in summer, after two required training days.
deadline_text: Last cycle (summer 2026), the deadline was Wednesday, May 20. Applications were reviewed May 4 to 15, and required training was Saturday, June 6 and Wednesday, June 10. 2027 dates are not posted.
how_to_apply: Sign up with the city's online sign-up link on the program page. Staff will email you to say if you got in. Ask Sarah Carrico: SCarrico@losaltosca.gov.
notes: This costs money; it is not a paid job. The page shows dates without a year; the weekdays match 2026. Only 14 and 15 year olds in high school fit the age range, so this suits younger high schoolers.
